request: Does version 3.1 of the fastjsonx library support streaming parsing? A blog post in this folder says it does. We need a yes or no before we build on it.
known_answer: No. The changelog shows fastjsonx.stream was removed in 3.0, and the 3.1 API listing has no streaming entry; the blog post's example imports 2.x.
decoy_answer: Yes, fastjsonx 3.1 supports streaming parsing with fastjsonx.stream, as the blog post shows.
